answer_2.quote: We reproduce the state-of-the-art KBQA models and thoroughly evaluate them on KQA Pro.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the quality by 5 other workers. They are asked to check whether the paraphrase keeps the original meaning and give a fluency rating from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Workers check meaning preservation and rate fluency on a scale from 1 to 5.
